There are three hair types—normal, dry, and oily—and each requires a different type of shampoo. If your hair is normal, it means it is at a healthy medium between the two extremes. If your hair is too dry it may look dull and appear brittle. On the other hand, if your hair is too oily, it may look greasy and shiny.
Knowing your hair type is important because it tells you what kind of shampoo you need. If you have dry hair, for example, you will need a moisturizing shampoo to add moisture to it.
